scope_note: Scans only the named ref ancestry, optionally its index/nonignored working files, and referenced local LFS payloads. Private rollback refs and unrelated ignored files are excluded. Heuristic scan is not a guarantee against every possible secret.

evidence_origin.curation: HEAD is displayed as the resolved exact commit; the original invocation ref is retained. Audit counts and limitations are unchanged; raw local logs are not published.
